title: Advanced Training Methodologies
description: Master optimizers, learning rate scheduling, normalization, regularization, data pipelines, mixed precision, and distributed training.
objectives: Compare and select optimizers (SGD, Adam, AdamW)
Use mixed precision and distributed training
keyTakeaways: Adam = momentum (1st moment) + RMSprop adaptive rates (2nd moment) with bias correction — works well out-of-the-box
Nesterov Accelerated Gradient evaluates the gradient at the look-ahead position, giving better convergence than vanilla momentum
LR schedules (cosine decay, warm restarts, one-cycle) outperform a fixed LR — start warm, decay to near-zero
Mixed precision (float16 compute + float32 master weights) gives ~2-3x speedup on modern GPUs with minimal accuracy loss
tf.data pipelines with prefetch + cache + parallel map eliminate I/O bottlenecks and keep the GPU fed
